title: 第七章神出鬼没的 F6第八章 疯狗
slug: 兽校开局被强吻我被疯批们娇宠
content_zh:
盛越回到别墅，当即进了浴室。
等出来，就发现别墅来了个不速之客。
“你怎么来了？”
“好奇。”裴殷手臂横枕在沙发上。
“校园网上那些照片，真的假的？你不是洁癖吗？怎么抱着个女同学跑？”
盛越愣住，被人发校园网上了？
没在意。
他思索片刻，坐到裴殷对面，全盘托出。
“真有这样的人？”裴殷听完，笑容收敛。
沉思良久，他打趣，“单单是闻到她身上味道就能压下异痛，你说，要是我亲一下她，是不是效果更好？”
裴殷兴致盎然，“我先去把她抓来！”
“等等，不一定就是她自己身上的味道。”盛越皱了皱眉，“这件事，我会去查的，等我查清楚再说。”
裴殷余光瞥向别墅外的人影，“晚了。你刚刚说的话，凌厌执那个疯子，好像都听到了。”
……
另一边。
简妤开心到想打滚，脸上却还是无比镇定的表情。
到账一百万星币，接下来可以不用那么节省了！
想起自己在这个世界的人设与现实中无异，她打开星脑，果断给院长转了二十万。
“你身体没什么大问题，小毛病倒是不少，休息休息就离开吧。”
校医在盛越走了两分钟左右，第一时间走了进来。

他一脸稀奇地打量简妤，“虽然学校饭菜贵了点，但也不能把你搞成营养不良的样子吧？”
学校二十个小食堂，七个大食堂。
饭菜价格最贵有三十多万一餐，最便宜也有五块钱的。
五块钱有肉有素，算是学校特意往里面贴补的助学餐。
即使是家境糟糕的特招生，也能吃得很好。
更别提，特招生考进这个学校，也会有三十万星币的奖励。
盛越亲自把人送过来，校医忍不住多提醒两句。
“你这胃经不起折腾，可别为了那点面子，跑去跟人家攀比，吃什么大餐，早早把身上的钱给耗光了。”
简妤抬头，眨了眨眼，“兼职比较多，有时候可能会忘记吃。以后不会了。”
原身的设定大概跟她高中时期同步了。
那三十万星币的升学奖励，她只留了一万，剩下全打给了院长妈妈。
校医忍不住打听，“你跟盛越同学，关系怎么样？”
“不熟。”简妤低头浏览起了校园网。
晕倒后发生了什么事，她不知道。
但醒来能看见盛越，这事估计闹得不小。
‘她火了’。简妤看着校园网上被盛越抱着离开教室的照片，得出这么个结论。
看来，她需要在校医室多住几天了。
简妤捂住肚子，“我感觉我身体还是有点不舒服。”
她眼睛上抬，无辜地盯着校医看。
“盛越同学都跟我说了，你之所以会晕过去，是因为服用了林教授带来的药剂。”

校医一眼看穿，“你的身体要比任何时候都要好。不过，从检查结果上看，药剂对你的作用似乎只有一半。”
content_en:
Sheng Yue returned to the villa and immediately entered the bathroom.
When I came out, I found an uninvited guest in the villa.
"Why are you here?"
"Curious." Pei Yin rested his arms on the sofa.
"Are those photos on campus online real or fake? Aren't you a germophobe? Why are you running away with a female classmate in your arms?"
Sheng Yue was stunned. Was he posted on the campus network?
Didn't care.
He thought for a moment, sat down opposite Pei Yin, and told everything.
"Is there really such a person?" After hearing this, Pei Yin's smile faded.
After pondering for a long time, he joked, "Just smelling her scent can suppress the pain. Do you think it would be better if I kissed her?"
Pei Yin was very interested, "I'll catch her first!"
"Wait, it doesn't necessarily mean the smell of her own body." Sheng Yue frowned, "I will check this matter and wait until I find out."
Pei Yin glanced at the figure outside the villa, "It's too late. That lunatic Ling Yanzhi seems to have heard what you just said."
…
other side.
Jian Yu was so happy that she wanted to roll over, but she still had an extremely calm expression on her face.
After receiving one million star coins, you don’t need to save so much anymore!
Remembering that her persona in this world was no different from reality, she opened her star brain and decisively transferred 200,000 yuan to the dean.
"You don't have any major health problems, but you have quite a few minor problems. Just take a rest and leave."
The school doctor walked in Shengyue for about two minutes and walked in immediately.
He looked at Jian Yu with a curious expression, "Although the school food is a bit expensive, it can't make you malnourished, right?"
The school has twenty small canteens and seven large canteens.
The most expensive meal costs more than 300,000 yuan per meal, while the cheapest meal costs only 5 yuan.
Five yuan contains both meat and vegetables, which is considered a student meal specially subsidized by the school.
Even special admissions students from poor families can still eat well.
Not to mention, special admissions students who enter this school will receive a reward of 300,000 star coins.
Sheng Yue personally sent the person over, and the school doctor couldn't help but give him a few more reminders.
"Your stomach can't stand it, so don't waste all your money early by comparing yourself to others for a little bit of face."
Jian Yu looked up and blinked, "I have a lot of part-time jobs, so sometimes I might forget to eat. I won't do that again."
The original setting is probably synchronized with her high school days.
She only kept 10,000 of the 300,000 star coins as a reward for entering higher education, and gave the rest to the dean's mother.
The school doctor couldn't help but ask, "How is your relationship with classmate Sheng Yue?"
"Not familiar." Jian Yu lowered her head and browsed the campus network.
She didn't know what happened after she fainted.
But when I woke up and saw Sheng Yue, this matter must have caused quite a fuss.
‘She’s on fire’. Jian Yu came to this conclusion after looking at the photos on the campus website of Sheng Yue leaving the classroom in his arms.
It seems that she needs to stay in the school doctor's office for a few more days.
Jian Yu covered her stomach, "I feel like I'm still feeling a little uncomfortable."
She raised her eyes and stared at the school doctor innocently.
"Classmate Sheng Yue told me that the reason why you fainted was because you took the medicine that Professor Lin brought."
The school doctor saw through it at a glance, "Your health is better than ever. However, judging from the examination results, the medicine seems to be only half effective on you."
